Dahej is a port and petrochemical hub. The Dahej PCPIR, the GIDC estate, the SEZ and the port and LNG terminals bring together bulk chemicals, petrochemicals, EPC projects and heavy logistics on the Gujarat coast. Operations like these need site, documentation and project offices that arrive finished and stand up to a coastal, chemical-adjacent setting. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller. As a Container Office Supplier for the Dahej PCPIR, we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory. This page covers what Dahej buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Dahej

Petrochemical and bulk-chemical projects use them as site, admin and safety cabins. LNG and port operators use them as documentation and gate cabins at the terminal belt. EPC contractors use them as project offices during construction and turnaround work. SEZ and warehousing operators use them as dispatch and weighbridge cabins. The common need is a rugged, well-finished cabin that arrives ready and handles the coastal, chemical-adjacent environment. (These are site/admin/documentation cabins placed within the estate or port belt — not process-area explosion-proof enclosures.)

Dahej industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the Dahej belt:

  • Dahej GIDC industrial estate (392130) — the core chemical and petrochemical estate; admin, site and documentation cabins.
  • Dahej SEZ / PCPIR belt (392130) — bulk chemical, petrochemical and processing units; supervisor and project offices.
  • Dahej port / LNG & chemical terminal belt (392130) — port, LNG and logistics operations; gate, documentation and weighbridge cabins.
  • The nearby Vilayat and Vagra industrial belt is also served; share the exact site when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Sites outside these pockets — along the Dahej–Bharuch road or the port approach roads — are also served.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Dahej
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite, admin or documentation cabin for a project
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

For a made-to-order requirement we can supply a site office container for petrochemical projects. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board — cement board suits humid, coastal, chemical-adjacent positions
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision
  • Optional extra corrosion protection for coastal/port use

Customisation options

Most Dahej orders are customised to the site. We can add: extra corrosion protection and cement-board panelling for coastal, chemical-adjacent positions; partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; dispatch-window and documentation-counter layouts for port and SEZ use; and ramps or external steps. Units can be a single relocatable office or a staged set for a large EPC project. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Dahej

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Dahej by road, roughly 1,100–1,170 km via the NH48 Delhi–Mumbai corridor to Vadodara and Bharuch, then the Dahej port/PCPIR road. It is a long but well-established route; we confirm the exact transit window at quotation. A default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport set by distance and GIDC / SEZ / port gate access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We also serve the Vadodara container office page on the same route, so the line into central Gujarat is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price, documentation and after-sales — which matters for petrochemical and EPC vendor onboarding. We supply across Gujarat, including container offices we ship to Surat and our Ahmedabad container office builds.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Dahej depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel type (PUF vs cement board for coastal/chemical positions), corrosion protection, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and the long-haul transport from our factory. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Dahej?

Price depends on size, panel type, corrosion protection, partitions, electricals and fit-out, plus long-haul transport from our Greater Noida factory. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

Are your cabins suited to a coastal, chemical-adjacent Dahej site?

As site, admin or documentation cabins, yes — and we can add corrosion protection and cement-board panelling suited to a coastal, chemical-adjacent position. Note these are site/admin cabins, not process-area explosion-proof enclosures; tell us the use and we advise on the right build.

How long does delivery take to Dahej?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, roughly 1,100–1,170 km away via the NH48 corridor and the Dahej port/PCPIR road. It is a long-haul route, so we confirm the exact transit window at order stage based on your site and gate access.

Can you supply a staged set of offices for a large EPC project?

Yes. Alongside single units we can supply a staged set of site and project offices for a large petrochemical or EPC build. Tell us the phasing and team sizes at order stage and we plan the units accordingly.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Dahej container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
